$comment: SCAFFOLD — the reversible half of member onboarding. It is INERT until a human arms it: auto_accept is false, and no email sends without ESTATE_SMTP_URL. Going live (flipping auto_accept true, wiring the IdP) is a steward move — see plan/processes/membership-onboarding.md. This file is prepared-and-proposed, never self-activated.
auto_accept_note: OFF by design. When on, a new registration is auto-admitted at read-only. Turning this on is Bob/Ken's explicit call and needs the live IdP.
capability_note: member = read + propose. Reading is open once admitted; CREATING anything is a proposal the Yes-Gate holds for Bob or Ken. A member never creates without approval.
rate_limit_note: At most one auto-onboarding per minute; the rest queue. Abuse throttle for open registration.

drip.cadence: welcome on admission, one email/day for days 1-14, then weekly
drip.feedback_note: every email ends with a feedback footer naming Ken and Bob with both addresses

brain_note: Keep all this traffic in the brain: every send emits a metadata-only ledger receipt (template id + recipient hash + timestamp) — never the body, never PII. The brain is the signed ledger.

monitoring.note: Every member effect is a proposal receipt; stewards see all, members see only their own. No new machinery — this is the governed core.
